_about: Declared graph for the SEALED-MODULE self-test case. Both direct linkers of the sealed module are carried as baselined sites with an owner and a removal phase, and no 'deps' entry names it. Expected: PASS.

synth_app._note: Links the sealed module. The link is carried by a SEAL site, not by a dep.

synth_tool._note: Declared so that its link to the sealed module is visible at all: an undeclared executable is invisible to the consumer allowlist.

sealed_modules.reason: While SEAL-baseline is open, synth_impl may be reached only through a baselined site: never through a 'deps' declaration, which check_targets() honours before it consults exceptions, and never by a target the ledger does not name.

exceptions.reason: Stands in for the real ledger of targets that still link the component-private module, each carried as a site with an owner and a removal phase. LOAD-BEARING, as in the real graph: sealed_while above matches exception ids as globs, so this id must keep matching 'SEAL-*' -- rename one without the other and the seal stops applying with nothing failing to say so.
